name: apple-photos
description: Apple Photos MCP server for Claude Desktop. 13 tools to search, look at, organise and export your own library, entirely on your Mac.
long_description:
Connects Claude to the Photos library on this Mac.

It searches Apple's own on-device index rather than filenames: scene labels, text read out of images, activities, places and named faces. It can also look at the pictures, which is the difference between describing a photo and guessing from its filename.

Nothing is uploaded. There is no account, no API key and no backend; macOS asks for permission the first time it reads the library, and everything stays on the machine.

Nothing here can delete a photo, because macOS does not permit it. Archiving moves items into an album for you to empty by hand, and it is the one tool that asks first.

Requires macOS and uv (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/), which fetches the Python engine on first run.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide every tool that can change the library. Searching, looking and exporting still work.

library.title: Photos library
library.description: Only needed if you keep your library somewhere other than ~/Pictures/Photos Library.photoslibrary.

export_dir.title: Where exports go
export_dir.description: Originals are written here. Defaults to ~/Downloads/Photos Exports.
